data.testimonial: Giddh's estimates and proforma invoices work seamlessly. We can create proformas and easily convert them into invoices, tracking their status as paid, unpaid, or partially paid. Automated WhatsApp messages and email notifications after creating vouchers significantly reduce manual effort.

Giddh offers multiple types of invoices, including cash and sales invoices, making billing flexible and convenient. The dashboard provides a clear summary of the business's health on a single screen, helping us instantly understand where we stand on any given day.

Giddh is an excellent platform for managing multiple companies seamlessly. It allows me to handle different businesses in real time, all in one place. Switching between companies is incredibly fast and effortless, making the entire process smooth and efficient.

Giddh is one of the easiest ledger-based accounting systems I've used. Creating ledger entries is quick and effortless, making it truly ready to go. Even someone without a strong accounting background can easily manage and run their business with it.

With Giddh, managing bank accounts is simple and hassle-free. Incomes and expenses can be tracked directly, and the built-in GST filing option makes compliance much easier. It's truly a great all-in-one solution.

Giddh provides a wide range of reports including financial statements, daybook, sales and purchase registers, inventory reports, and GST reports. Having all these reports in one place makes managing business insights simple and efficient.

Giddh is a great solution to manage customers and invoices internationally. The multi-currency option makes it very convenient, and generating invoices is simple and quick. I can also easily manage VAT reports in the UK. The support team is patient, understands the challenges we face, and resolves them effectively.

data.company: Teknoworth Medical Care OPC Pvt Ltd
data.testimonial: Giddh is the most reliable application for inventory management in both India and the UAE. Managing data is effortless, and the mobile app works flawlessly, ensuring smooth operations anytime, anywhere.
The application works seamlessly, allowing multiple users to access it in real time without any limits or lags. Multi-login functionality is effortless, making collaboration smooth and efficient.

The support team is excellent, and the latest version of Giddh comes packed with powerful features. Giddh can be accessed from anywhere with just an internet connection, making it highly convenient and reliable.
The inventory reports work brilliantly. Creating parent and child groups is simple and effective, allowing the inventory to be organized and bifurcated properly for better clarity.

The inventory module in Giddh is extremely powerful. Its variant creation feature allows multiple variants for a single item, which is very helpful for detailed inventory management. The barcode scanning feature further completes the requirements, making the process fast and efficient.
Support connects positively when needed. The ledger accounting module makes it easy to create entries; I can easily manage my expenses by creating the accounts and making entries there.

The inventory management helps in restaurant management and the branch creation helps to manage multiple branches under a single platform. It helps to see the branch profiles along with the warehouses.

faqs.question: What is Place of Supply in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Place of Supply is a new field in the invoice module. You select which state or location should be used for GST calculation. It works separately from the billing and shipping address.

faqs.question: How does Stock History work?
faqs.answer: While creating a voucher, select a customer and add an item. Click the Stock History icon next to the item to see previous prices, quantities, and voucher details for that item with that customer.

faqs.question: What is Copy from Previous Voucher?
faqs.answer: After selecting a customer or supplier, you can view related voucher history, preview details, and copy information into the current invoice or bill. You can see up to 10 recent vouchers instead of 5.

faqs.question: How does Giddh calculate GST on invoices?
faqs.answer: Giddh applies CGST, SGST, or IGST based on the Place of Supply you select, along with your tax settings. It also supports TDS and TCS on invoices for complete tax compliance.

faqs.question: Does Giddh support recurring invoicing?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can create and automate recurring invoices for clients on a fixed billing cycle, with payment reminders to help you get paid on time.

faqs.question: Are my invoices secure in Giddh cloud invoicing software?
faqs.answer: Yes. Giddh uses encrypted cloud storage with role-based access controls to keep your invoice and financial data safe.

faqs.question: Can I customize invoice templates in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Yes. Giddh offers multiple invoice templates that you can customize to match your business branding.

faqs.question: How do I create estimates and convert them to invoices?
faqs.answer: Create an estimate or proforma invoice in Giddh and convert it to a final invoice with one click — no need to re-enter the data.

faqs.question: Which is the best free invoicing software in India?
faqs.answer: Giddh is among the best free invoicing software options in India, offering GST compliance, Place of Supply control, Stock History, voucher copying, and cloud access at no cost.

faqs.question: Can I send invoices via WhatsApp from Giddh?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can send invoices directly via WhatsApp, email, or SMS from Giddh — so your customers receive bills on the channel they prefer.
